mission: Unhurried, joined-up care, with the fee known before you walk in.

hero.headline: Unhurried care, all under one roof
hero.lead: Six clinicians who share one building and talk to each other. Long appointments, plain answers, and a fee you know before you book.

story.heading: It started with two rooms and a longer appointment
paragraphs: I opened Fernway in 2011 with two treatment rooms and one rule: nobody gets rushed. A first physio visit ran 45 minutes then, and it still does.

People kept asking who we would send them to for their teeth, or for someone to talk to. So we moved to a bigger building in 2015 and brought those clinicians in. Now your physio, your dentist and your psychologist can share notes, with your say-so, instead of starting from nothing.
We are still a small clinic. You will see the same faces, and we will tell you the fee before you book.

milestones.text: Priya Nair opens Fernway as a two-room physiotherapy practice.
Tom Hargreave joins and starts the sports physio clinic.
We move to the current building and Dr Elena Marsh opens the dental rooms.
Sam Whitlock joins as our oral health therapist.
Dr Hannah Reyes brings psychology into the clinic.
Dr Lucas Brandt joins the psychology team.
The rehab gym opens on the ground floor.

stats.label: New patients seen in the same week

features.title: Time to listen
features.text: First visits run 45 to 50 minutes, so you can tell the whole story once.

features.title: One team, one plan
features.text: Your physio, dentist and psychologist work in the same building and can share notes when you ask them to.

features.title: Fees known first
features.text: Every fee is on this site. You hear the cost before any treatment starts.

features.title: Seen this week
features.text: Most new patients get a time within the week, with early and Saturday slots.

features.title: Registered clinicians
features.text: Every clinician is named here with a registration you can check on the public register.

features.title: Easy to get into
features.text: Step-free entrance, an accessible toilet and a quiet waiting area for anyone who needs it.

payments.title: Card and tap
payments.text: Pay by card, phone or watch at the front desk.

payments.title: On-the-spot claims
payments.text: Swipe your fund or plan card and pay only the gap, where your cover allows it.

payments.title: Payment plans
payments.text: Longer dental treatment can be spread over interest-free instalments.

careers.heading: Work with us
careers.text: We hire slowly and keep people for a long time. Clinicians here get long appointments, paid learning days and a team that eats lunch together.

roles.title: Physiotherapist
roles.text: Three or more years in musculoskeletal practice. An interest in persistent pain is welcome.

roles.title: Dental assistant
roles.text: Chairside support for our dentist and oral health therapist. We will train the right person.

roles.title: Patient coordinator
roles.text: The first voice people hear. Calm on the phone and good with a full diary.

newsletter.heading: One useful health tip a month
newsletter.text: Short, practical notes from our clinicians. No sales emails, and you can leave any time.
